fact: The Ministry of Finance states its e-collection and payment system Esali has run since early 2024, enabling Cabinet decisions 149 and 150 on cashless government dealings, salaries paid through bank accounts and government payments made electronically via accounts at the Central Bank, and that Esali is integrated with ASYCUDA.
title: وزارة المالية تؤكد استمرار إصلاح المالية العامة وفق خارطة طريق متكاملة
